title: Bidirectional Centered Score Matching for Discrete Diffusion Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.04279v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Discrete diffusion models with parallel decoding are often distilled using token-wise KL objectives. Although token-wise KL exactly matches the corresponding product-form block distributions, its probability-space optimization geometry and teacher-only candidate truncation may provide insufficient supervision under aggressive few-step distillation. Concrete Score Matching (CSM) provides an alternative within-position objective by aligning relative logit geometry, but its complete pairwise form incurs \mathcal{O}(|\mathcal{V}|^2) complexity. translated_title: 离散扩散蒸馏的双向中心化得分匹配
translated_abstract: 具有并行解码的离散扩散模型通常采用逐词元的KL散度目标进行蒸馏。尽管逐词元的KL能够精确匹配相应的乘积形式块分布，但其概率空间的优化几何结构以及仅基于教师模型的候选截断，在激进的多步压缩（few-step）蒸馏场景下可能提供不足的监督信号。具体得分匹配通过在位置内部对齐相对logit几何结构提供了一种替代性目标，但其完整的成对形式会带来 O(|V|²) 的计算复杂度。我们提出双向中心化得分匹配（BCSM），这是一种高效的位置内部蒸馏目标，它构建了一个 O(K) 规模的双向活动集，将成对比较的复杂度降至 O(K²)，并将其分解为 O(K) 的目标函数。我们还进一步引入了跨时间步的转移对齐机制。实验结果表明，该方法在质量与效率之间取得了出色的权衡。
tldr: 提出双向中心化得分匹配（BCSM），一种面向离散扩散模型的高效位置内蒸馏目标，将CSM的O(|V|²)复杂度降低至O(K)，并通过跨时间步转移对齐在少步蒸馏中实现更优的质量-效率权衡。
en_tdlr: We propose Bidirectional Centered Score Matching (BCSM), an efficient within-position distillation objective for discrete diffusion models that reduces CSM's O(|V|²) complexity to O(K) and introduces cross-timestep transition alignment, achieving strong quality-efficiency trade-offs in few-step distillation.
